description: This file defines data structures, types, and functions related to 'boards' and 'blocks' in a project, including creation, comparison, and patch generation for board configurations and properties.

methods.name: createBoard
methods.description: Creates a new Board object, optionally cloning properties from an existing board, and assigns default values where necessary.

methods.name: getPropertiesDifference
methods.description: Returns a list of property IDs present in the first list but not in the second.

methods.name: isPropertyEqual
methods.description: Checks if two property templates are equal, including their options.

methods.name: createCardPropertiesPatches
methods.description: Generates patches for updating card properties, including delta and undo patches.

methods.name: createPatchesFromBoards
methods.description: Creates delta and undo patches for changes between two Board objects.

methods.name: createPatchesFromBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Creates patches for updates involving a board and its associated blocks, including undo patches.
